title: Mediating technical conflict between people and between teams

videos.script: Checkout's tech lead writes that logistics' database quota is absurd. Logistics replies within a minute. By lunchtime the thread has sixty messages. {{title}} It looks like an argument about a number. It is three arguments at once: about the work, about who decides, and about the people. {{kinds}} Lívia's first move is to take it out of the channel. Nobody changes position in front of an audience. {{call}} Then one question to each side. What happens if you don't get that number? The answers sit at different hours of the day, and the solution falls out of them. {{quotas}} The rest of the lesson is what to do when it doesn't. Agree the criteria before the options. Find the shared thing nobody owns. And when you escalate, escalate together, with one page.
